svg.text: Phase 5 · milestone 2 · What's due: layout options
Dark theme. Yellow "Coming up" at 20% left (60 days for dates), orange "Due soon" 10% (30), red "Due very soon" 5% (14), "⚠ Overdue" darker red.
Each requirement: its step, what's left, and the projected date (~ is an estimate).
1A · A chip and a coloured edge
Today's cards, with the step on the left edge
in 310 mi or Oil life 9% · ~19 Nov

The card shows its vehicle's most urgent step; nothing when all is OK.

Due very soon · Oil change in 310 mi
